question: The actual or realised value of a variable as opposed to its planned value is called _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ex post**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The actual or realised value of a variable,** as opposed to its planned value, is called **Ex post**.
 
• **Ex-post, **which means "after the fact" in Latin, is another term for actual returns.
 
• The most well-known method for predicting the likelihood of experiencing a loss on investment on any given day has traditionally been to use previous results.
 
• Ex-post stands in contrast to ex-ante, which is Latin for "before the event." Companies gather ex-post data in order to project future earnings.
 
• Studies like value at risk (VaR), and probability research that estimates the greatest loss an investment portfolio may sustain on any given day, make use of ex-post information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **ExFlow** is a special add-on module for Microsoft Dynamics AX and Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Finance & Operations that improves your accounts payable and procurement operations' productivity and efficiency over the long term.

 
• **Ex-ante** refers to future occurrences, such as potential returns on a certain security or firm returns.
 
• Instead of selling or exchanging items for money, parties to a **barter** agreement transfer goods or commodities for other goods.
